purpose: Break-glass emergency recovery only for the clean operator-created MAIN canonical. Normal continuity is SAME MAIN END+60 plus SAME MAIN recurring schedule. Retired MAIN canonicals are never recovery targets.

normal_monitoring.rationale: Normal monitoring and per-turn arming are intentionally removed. The current operator-created MAIN must be self-reliant.

startup_receipts.boot_started_rule: MAIN writes BOOT_STARTED immediately after minimum fresh NOW/CURRENT/canonical/fence validation and before provisional arm/full restore/substantive work.
startup_receipts.rearm_verified_rule: MAIN writes REARM_VERIFIED immediately after same-canonical provisional continuation is successfully mutated and verified.
startup_receipts.generation_key: main_expected_due_at plus newest durable schedule/authority generation available at bootstrap; missing data must remain unknown rather than inferred.

classifications.HEALTHY_BOOTSTRAP: Generation-matched BOOT_STARTED and REARM_VERIFIED exist, or newer unambiguous durable state proves bootstrap and continuation succeeded.
classifications.STARTUP_ACK_MISSING: now >= MAIN expected_due + 180s and no generation-matched BOOT_STARTED/equivalent newer bootstrap evidence exists.
classifications.BOOTSTRAP_REARM_MISSING: BOOT_STARTED exists but REARM_VERIFIED/newer verified continuation does not exist after the configured grace.
classifications.WATCHDOG_AMBIGUOUS: Pause/terminal state, authority, due generation, receipts, or live MAIN metadata conflict enough that mutation cannot be proven safe.
classifications.IDLE_DISTANT_DUE: Program is CONTINUE, MAIN is enabled, fresh durable state proves there is no active substantive turn, a last observed closed-turn END is known, and live MAIN due is later than (last closed END + 60s + 120s). A WORKING/ambiguous owner is never classified idle by timeout guess alone.

main_sync_contract.normal_close: DO_NOT_ARM_WATCHDOG. MAIN normal close verifies only SAME MAIN END+60 and durable close projection.
main_sync_contract.failure_semantics: Watchdog being disabled is healthy normal state, not degraded coverage.
main_sync_contract.pause_terminal: Explicit operator PAUSED/STOP or durable terminal prevents any emergency wake.

prompt_sync_contract.rule: GitHub policy is authoritative. MAIN must not arm this Watchdog during normal turns. Emergency recovery may target only the fresh CURRENT canonical, never either retired predecessor.

self_rearm_contract.invariant: Automatic Watchdog self-relay is not part of normal operation and is disabled by default.
self_rearm_contract.success_condition: For an explicitly activated emergency run, any mutation must preserve the same canonical and be live-verified.
self_rearm_contract.failure_condition: Fail closed; do not create a replacement Watchdog.
self_rearm_contract.reason: Normal correctness must never depend on Watchdog self-relay.

idle_distant_due_guard.purpose: Retired from normal operation. MAIN recurring RRULE is the built-in cold fallback.
idle_distant_due_guard.idle_proof_rule: Use fresh durable state, not absence of recent chat/tool output. Treat idle as proven only when no fresh CURRENT/ACTIVITY/HANDOFF/startup evidence establishes an active substantive owner and the latest applicable run has an observed close boundary.
idle_distant_due_guard.expected_fast_due_rule: latest observed eligible closed-turn END + 60 seconds
idle_distant_due_guard.trigger_rule: MAIN enabled=true AND program CONTINUE AND idle proven AND live MAIN due > expected_fast_due + 120 seconds.
idle_distant_due_guard.active_provisional_exemption: A verified future +660-second provisional continuation, or one guarded extension belonging to a proven active WORKING turn, is healthy crash insurance and MUST NOT be pulled forward by this disabled guard.
idle_distant_due_guard.missing_boundary_rule: If latest closed END or owner state is unknown/conflicting, do not infer idle or expected fast due; classify WATCHDOG_AMBIGUOUS and recheck.
idle_distant_due_guard.recovery: Rearm only the SAME MAIN canonical to now+60s with is_enabled=true and verify live metadata, but only after explicit break-glass activation.
